    }

    internal fun raiseMark(premise: PremiseKey, input: Facts, mark: TaintMark) {
        if (!RuntimeDataDomain.packet(premise, input)) return
        check(config.run1) { "Requests exist only in run 1" }
        check(input is FlowTree && premise is InitialAp) { "A request needs a FLOW input premise" }
        check(premise.base != STATIC) { "A static-origin interest needs an exact operation input" }
        addMarkRequest(premise, mark)
    }

    internal fun operation(node: CommonInst, ordinal: Int = 0): OperationId =
        OperationId(FormKey(operationOwner, key.method, key, node), ordinal)

    internal fun forceRun1Layer(premise: PremiseKey, value: Facts): Facts {
        if (!config.run1) return value
        return run1Layer(premise, ops.runtimeFact(value, mode))
    }

    /** FULL uses the ordinary AP layer. GROUP projection and the independent
     * run-1 static approximation keep their DEMAND policy. */
    private fun run1Layer(premise: PremiseKey, value: Facts): Facts {
        return if ((value is TaintTree && mode.markMode == MarkMode.GROUP) || value.base == STATIC ||
            Run1StaticService.hasStaticMember(premise)) value.withLayer(Layer.DEMAND) else value
    }

    internal fun collect(at: OperationInput, sink: ResultSink): ApOut {
        return object : ApOut {
            override fun result(f: Facts) {
                if (!RuntimeDataDomain.packet(at.premise, at.facts) || !RuntimeDataDomain.packet(at.premise, f)) return
                val value = forceRun1Layer(at.premise, f)
                if (config.run1) ops.run1Cover(value) { sink(at.premise, it) } else sink(at.premise, value)
            }
            override fun markRequest(mark: TaintMark) = needGroups(at, mark)
        }
    }

    /** Only for the immediate callback from this actor's ops.applyEdge run1Policy.
     * That policy already projected and covered each result with this AP manager. */
    internal fun collectAfterRun1Policy(at: OperationInput, sink: ResultSink): ApOut {
        return object : ApOut {
            override fun result(f: Facts) {
                if (!RuntimeDataDomain.packet(at.premise, at.facts) || !RuntimeDataDomain.packet(at.premise, f)) return
                val value = if (config.run1) run1Layer(at.premise, f) else f
                if (config.run1) ops.run1Cover(value) { sink(at.premise, it) } else sink(at.premise, value)
            }
            override fun markRequest(mark: TaintMark) = needGroups(at, mark)
        }
    }

    internal fun needGroups(at: OperationInput, mark: TaintMark) {
        if (!RuntimeDataDomain.packet(at.premise, at.facts)) return
        if (!config.run1) return
        val original = at.premise as? InitialAp ?: return
        if (at.facts !is FlowTree || original.mark !is MarkSlot.Star) return
        if (dropsStaticField(original)) return
        val atom = ap.marks.runtimeAtom(mark, mode.markMode)
        if (original.base == STATIC) {
            checkNotNull(pointResumes).request(at, MarkSet.of(atom))
            binding?.staticMarkRequest(original, atom)
        } else addMarkRequest(original, atom)
    }

    /** FULL block requests share one immutable image and one raw suffix address. */
    internal fun needGroups(at: OperationInput, marks: MarkSet) {
        if (!RuntimeDataDomain.packet(at.premise, at.facts)) return
        if (!config.run1 || marks.isEmpty) return
        val original = at.premise as? InitialAp ?: return
        if (at.facts !is FlowTree || original.mark !is MarkSlot.Star || dropsStaticField(original)) return
        check(mode.markMode == MarkMode.FULL)
        if (original.base == STATIC) {
            checkNotNull(pointResumes).request(at, marks)
            for (id in marks.ids) binding?.staticMarkRequest(original, TaintMark(id))
        } else addMarkRequests(original, RequestMarkSet.fromIds(marks.ids))
    }

    internal fun reachedOperations(summary: StatementSummary, at: OperationInput) {
        if (!RuntimeDataDomain.packet(at.premise, at.facts)) return
        if (config.run1) checkNotNull(pointResumes).reached(summary, at)
    }

    internal fun emitOperationResult(at: OperationInput, operation: StaticOperation.Write?, value: Facts, sink: ResultSink) {
        if (!RuntimeDataDomain.packet(at.premise, at.facts) || !RuntimeDataDomain.packet(at.premise, value)) return
        if (dropsStaticPremise(at.premise)) return
        val admitted = withoutDisabledStaticFields(value) ?: return
        val runtime = forceRun1Layer(at.premise, admitted)
        if (config.run1 && runtime.base == STATIC) {
            val boundary = at.site as? ResumeSite.BoundaryInput
            if (operation != null) {
                boundedSummaryResult(at.premise, runtime) { premise, bounded ->
                    if (boundary != null && !boundary.atStart &&
                        context.isEnd(boundary.operation.form.statement) &&
                        !context.isExceptionalExit(boundary.operation.form.statement)) {
                        // The next exit-rule continuation can kill this executed
                        // write before the final boundary result is available.
                        checkNotNull(staticWriteCandidates).observe(premise, bounded)
                    }
                    // A real write becomes globally visible at the producer,
                    // independently of its later exit rules and summary.
                    checkNotNull(pointResumes).localWrite(premise, bounded)
                    if (boundary != null && !boundary.atStart) sink(premise, bounded)
                    else routeBoundedRun1StaticToExit(at.site.operation.form.statement, premise, bounded)
                }
            } else if (boundary != null && !boundary.atStart) {
                // This value already belongs to an exit-rule pipeline. Finish
                // its remaining rules; never schedule NormalExit again.
                sink(at.premise, runtime)
            }
            return
        }

        sink(at.premise, runtime)
    }

    open fun onStaticEffect(effect: StaticOwnerEffect) {
        check(config.run1 && effect.owner == key)
        checkNotNull(pointResumes).onEffect(effect)
    }

    internal fun staticFacts(slice: RegionGroups): Facts = checkNotNull(runnerPort.staticService).facts(slice.region, slice.groups)
    internal fun staticSlices(facts: Facts): List<RegionGroups> = checkNotNull(runnerPort.staticService).slices(facts)
    internal fun staticCallInterest(part: Subscription, result: StaticCallResult, member: Int) {
        if (!dropsStaticField(result.premise.member(member)))
            checkNotNull(pointResumes).callInterest(part, result, member)
    }
    internal fun staticCallSupply(part: Subscription, result: StaticCallResult, member: Int, supply: RegionGroups) =
        callServices.staticSupply(part, result, member, supply)

    /** These published run-1 originals have already received their canonical pool input. */
    internal fun hasKnownStaticGroupInput(premise: PremiseKey): Boolean =
        config.run1 && premise is InitialAp &&
            premise.base == STATIC && premise.mark is MarkSlot.Concrete &&
            premise.exclusion == ExclusionSet.Empty &&
            ((premise.pathData.size == 2 && premise.tail == Tail.STAR) ||
                (premise.pathData.size == 1 && premise.tail == Tail.EXACT))

    internal fun knownStaticInput(initial: InitialAp): Facts {
        check(hasKnownStaticGroupInput(initial))
        return ops.startFact(initial, mode)
    }

    private fun boundedStaticSummaryOut(premise: PremiseKey, emit: (Facts) -> Unit): ApOut = object : ApOut {
        override fun result(f: Facts) {
            if (f is TaintTree) {
                // Static effects leave the ordinary call suffix early. Apply
                // the same field limit that suffix would apply to its result.
                ops.limit(forceRun1Layer(premise, f), limit, collect(premise, f) { _, bounded -> emit(bounded) })
            }
        }
        override fun markRequest(mark: TaintMark) = Unit // summary application is not rule execution
    }

    internal fun composeStaticSummaryWithActualInput(initial: InitialAp, value: Facts, actual: Facts,
                                                    emit: (Facts) -> Unit) {
        checkPremise(initial)
        for (packet in ap.canonicalPackets(actual)) {
            val matched = ops.matchSummary(packet, initial, mode, nativeRecordRead = false,
                role = SummaryMatchRole.CURRENT) ?: continue
            ops.applySummary(matched, initial, value, mode, boundedStaticSummaryOut(initial, emit))
        }
    }

    /** Apply a complete static tuple on this owner after releasing the service lock. */
    internal fun composeStaticSummary(premise: PremiseKey, value: Facts, inputs: List<RegionGroups>, emit: (Facts) -> Unit) {
        checkPremise(premise)
        when (premise) {
            is InitialAp -> if (premise.isZero) { if (value is TaintTree) emit(value.withLayer(Layer.DEMAND)) }
                else if (inputs.size == 1) {
                    composeStaticSummaryWithActualInput(premise, value, staticFacts(inputs.single()), emit)
                }
            is PremiseSet -> if (inputs.size == premise.size && value is TaintTree) {
                val parts = inputs.mapIndexed { i, slice ->
                    ap.cancellation.checkpoint()
                    val initial = premise.member(i)
                    // Complete tuples use only each matched input's layer (W7). Canonical
                    // splits preserve that layer, so one existing match witnesses this arm.
                    val matched = ap.canonicalPackets(staticFacts(slice)).firstNotNullOfOrNull { packet ->
                        ops.matchSummary(packet, initial, mode, nativeRecordRead = false,
                            role = SummaryMatchRole.CURRENT)
                    } ?: return
                    matched to initial
                }
                ops.applyCombination(parts, value, mode, boundedStaticSummaryOut(premise, emit))
            }
        }
    }

    internal fun installPoint(premise: PremiseKey, value: Facts, site: ResumeSite, state: CallResumeState? = null) {
        if (!RuntimeDataDomain.packet(premise, value)) return
        check(config.run1)
        checkPremise(premise)
        if (dropsStaticPremise(premise)) return
        val admitted = withoutDisabledStaticFields(value) ?: return
        premise.forEachMember { validateRun1Initial(it, limit) }
        val runtime = forceRun1Layer(premise, admitted)
        checkKinds(premise, runtime)
        nonZeroInitial = nonZeroInitial || !premise.isZero
        resumeQueue.addLast(PointWork(premise, runtime, site, state))
        requestWork()
    }

    internal fun cut(point: Cut, premise: PremiseKey, facts: Facts, sink: ResultSink) {
        if (!RuntimeDataDomain.packet(premise, facts)) return
        runnerPort.onCut?.invoke(point, facts)
        val checkedSink: ResultSink = if (!checkRun2StaticAnchors) sink else { pr, bounded ->
            validateStaticFullAnchors(bounded)
            sink(pr, bounded)
        }
        val out = collect(premise, facts, checkedSink)
        if (config.run1) ops.run1Cover(facts) { ops.limit(it, limit, out) }
        else ops.limit(facts, limit, out)
    }

    /** Current result headers stay unchanged. Only query/seed admission requires
     * EXACT/ANY with empty E; other bounded field facts can retain MUST/E. */
    private fun validateStaticFullAnchors(facts: Facts) {
        if (facts !is TaintTree || facts.base != STATIC) return
        for (leaf in ops.leaves(facts)) validateRun2StaticFullAnchor(ap, leaf)
    }

    private val hasPendingAbstractionWork: Boolean get() =
        !temporary.isEmpty || !staticBatch.isEmpty || resumeQueue.isNotEmpty()

    internal val hasLocalWork: Boolean get() = !worklist.isEmpty || pending.isNotEmpty() ||
        localPublications.isNotEmpty() || pendingTargets.isNotEmpty() || hasPendingAbstractionWork
    internal val localHasZeroWork: Boolean get() = worklist.hasZeroWork
    internal val localHasFlowWork: Boolean get() = worklist.hasFlowWork

    private fun commitRequests() {
        if (!config.run1 || temporary.isEmpty) return
        if (temporarySinceNanos != 0L)
            context.shared.requestBatchStatistics?.serviceDelay(System.nanoTime() - temporarySinceNanos)
        if (binding != null) binding.commitRequests(this, temporary) else runnerPort.summaryStorage(key).commit(temporary)
        context.shared.abstractionStatistics?.temporaryChanged(-temporary.dynamicRows.toLong(), -temporary.dynamicMembers)
        temporary = RequestStorage() // replace only after synchronous commit and secured sends
        temporarySinceNanos = 0L
    }

    open fun work(quantum: Int): Boolean = workLocal(quantum)

    internal fun workLocal(quantum: Int): Boolean {
        require(quantum > 0) { "The work quantum must be positive" }
        checkNotNull(port) { "The method is frozen" }
        val zeroAtStart = worklist.hasZeroWork
        var processed = 0
        while (true) {
            ap.cancellation.checkpoint()
            while (resumeQueue.isNotEmpty()) {
                if (processed >= quantum) return false
                processed++
                val resume = resumeQueue.removeFirst()
                when (val site = resume.site) {
                    is ResumeSite.StatementInput -> runStatement(EdgeDelta(resume.premise, site.operation.form.statement, resume.facts))
                    is ResumeSite.BoundaryInput -> if (site.atStart) startAt(resume.premise, site.operation.form.statement, resume.facts)
                        else endAt(resume.premise, site.operation.form.statement, resume.facts,
                            summary = !context.isExceptionalExit(site.operation.form.statement))
                    is ResumeSite.ReadOutput -> installPoint(resume.premise, resume.facts, site.input, resume.state)
                    is ResumeSite.CallStageInput, is ResumeSite.CleanerInput -> callServices.resumePoint(resume.premise, resume.facts, site, resume.state)
                }
            }
            while (!worklist.isEmpty) {
                // Keep the zero phase separate. A quantum yield retains P without publishing it;
                // only the method fact-queue-empty boundary commits request memberships.
                if (worklist.hasZeroWork != zeroAtStart) return false
                if (processed >= quantum) {
                    return false
                }
                if (mode.run1 && mode.markMode == MarkMode.FULL)
                    processed += processPending(worklist.removeNextBatch(), quantum - processed)
                else {
                    processed++
                    process(worklist.removeNext())
                }
            }
            flushPublications()
            ap.cancellation.checkpoint()
            if (!worklist.isEmpty || pending.isNotEmpty() || localPublications.isNotEmpty() || pendingTargets.isNotEmpty()) continue
            commitRequests()
            if (config.run1 && !staticBatch.isEmpty) {
                val committed = staticBatch
                val effects = checkNotNull(runnerPort.staticService) { "Run-1 needs its static service" }.commit(committed)
                staticBatch = StaticBatch(staticSupplyProfile, ap.cancellation, context.shared.n2Statistics)
                for (effect in effects) check(runnerPort.sendStatic(effect)) { "Static effect delivery was rejected" }
            }
            ap.cancellation.checkpoint()
            // Retain the counted Work reservation through P commit/replacement and sends.
            if (worklist.isEmpty && pending.isEmpty() && localPublications.isEmpty() && pendingTargets.isEmpty() && !hasPendingAbstractionWork) return true
        }
    }

    private fun process(item: EdgeDelta) {
        if (!RuntimeDataDomain.packet(item.premise, item.facts)) return
        ap.cancellation.checkpoint()
        localSteps++
        bodyWork?.processed(context.shared.language.getInstIndex(item.node), item.premise, item.facts)
        runnerPort.onProcess?.invoke(key, item)
        if (config.run1 && item.facts.base == STATIC && context.isEnd(item.node))
            completeMethodBoundary(item.premise, item.node, item.facts, summary = true)
        else if (context.callAt(item.node) != null) callServices.process(item) else runStatement(item)
    }

    /** A batch can cross only a certified plain statement. Keep a remainder
     * counted as work before any successor, yield or request/static barrier. */
    private fun processPending(work: PendingWork, budget: Int): Int {
        if (work is PendingWork.Scalar) {
            process(work.delta)
            return 1
        }
        work as PendingWork.MarkedBatch
        val node = work.node
        var used = 0
        val plainPoint = binding == null && rootRouting == null && context.callAt(node) == null && !context.isEnd(node) &&
            !context.isExceptionalExit(node) && runnerPort.onProcess == null && runnerPort.onCut == null &&
            !dropsStaticField(work.batch.initialShape)
        if (plainPoint) forms.withStatement(key, node) { summary ->
            if (!NeutralRelationBatch.certifies(summary)) return@withStatement
            val chunk = work.batch.take(budget)
            used = chunk.size
            worklist.addBatch(node, work.batch)
            localSteps += used
            localNeutralBatchApplications++
            localNeutralBatchMemberships += used
            check(chunk.applyPacked(ops, summary, mode,
                emit = { shape, facts, marks -> emitPackedAfter(node, shape, facts, marks) },
                untouched = { shape, facts, marks ->
                    NeutralRelationBatch.decodePacked(ap, shape, facts, marks) { premise, value ->
                        emitUnchanged(EdgeDelta(premise, node, value))
                    }
                }))
        }
        if (used != 0) return used
        val (premise, facts) = work.batch.removeFirst()
        worklist.addBatch(node, work.batch)
        process(EdgeDelta(premise, node, facts))
        return 1
    }

    private fun emitPackedAfter(node: CommonInst, shape: InitialAp, facts: TaintTree, marks: MarkSet) {
        if (!RuntimeDataDomain.packet(shape, facts)) return
        val offered = NeutralRelationBatch.toDiagonal(ap, shape, facts, marks)
        if (offered == null) {
            // Classify once, then use the exact decoder for an unsupported
            // tail or partial-protection cell. No scalar tree is built first.
            localNeutralScalarFallbackMemberships += marks.size
            NeutralRelationBatch.decodePacked(ap, shape, facts, marks) { premise, value -> emitAfter(premise, node, value) }
            return
        }
        check(!context.isEnd(node) && !context.isExceptionalExit(node))
        val fresh = edges.addDiagonal(node, offered)
        if (fresh == null) {
            // Decode once at the producer, before successor fan-out.
            localNeutralScalarFallbackMemberships += marks.size
            NeutralRelationBatch.decodePacked(ap, shape, facts, marks) { premise, value ->
                completeOutput(premise, node, value)
            }
        } else for (delta in fresh) {
            ap.cancellation.checkpoint()
            localNeutralBulkStorePackets++
            localNeutralBulkStoreMemberships += delta.marks.size
            localEdgeDeltas += delta.marks.size
            if (delta.layer == Layer.DEMAND) localDemandLayerEdges += delta.marks.size
            context.forEachSuccessor(node) { successor ->
                context.forEachDeliveryTarget(successor, delta.base) { target ->
                    // Each queued destination owns its mutable remaining-mark wrapper.
                    worklist.addBatch(target, checkNotNull(NeutralRelationBatch.fromDiagonal(ap, delta)))
                    requestWork()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun runStatement(item: EdgeDelta) {
        forms.withStatement(key, item.node) { summary ->
            applier.statement(summary, item.premise, item.facts,
                Place(item.node, config.run1, sources = true, site = ResumeSite.StatementInput(operation(item.node))),
                sink = { premise, result ->
                    cut(Cut.STATEMENT, premise, result) { pr, facts -> emitAfter(pr, item.node, facts) }
                }, untouched = { _, _ -> emitUnchanged(item) })
        }
    }

    internal fun emitAfter(premise: PremiseKey, node: CommonInst, value: Facts) {
        if (!RuntimeDataDomain.packet(premise, value)) return
        checkPremise(premise)
        if (config.run1 && value.base == STATIC && !context.isEnd(node)) return
        if (config.run1) ops.run1Cover(forceRun1Layer(premise, value)) { emitCovered(premise, node, it) }
        else emitCovered(premise, node, value)
    }

    private fun emitCovered(premise: PremiseKey, node: CommonInst, facts: Facts) {
        when {
            context.isEnd(node) -> completeMethodBoundary(premise, node, facts, summary = true)
            context.isExceptionalExit(node) -> completeMethodBoundary(premise, node, facts, summary = false)
            else -> completeOutput(premise, node, facts)
        }
    }

    private fun completeMethodBoundary(premise: PremiseKey, node: CommonInst, facts: Facts, summary: Boolean) {
        if (binding != null) binding.methodBoundary(this, node, premise, facts, summary)
        else endAt(premise, node, facts, summary)
    }

    internal fun emitUnchanged(item: EdgeDelta) {
        if (!RuntimeDataDomain.packet(item.premise, item.facts)) return
        checkPremise(item.premise)
        if (config.run1 && item.facts.base == STATIC && !context.isEnd(item.node)) return
        emitCovered(item.premise, item.node, item.facts)
    }

    /** One durable result row per producer. Identity output uses this gate too. */
    private fun completeOutput(premise: PremiseKey, node: CommonInst, facts: Facts) {
        for (fresh in admitOutput(node, premise, facts)) {
            // Complete fan-out while the current Work reservation is held.
            if (binding != null) binding.successors(this, node, premise, fresh)
            else if (rootRouting != null) checkNotNull(rootRouting).successors(node, premise, fresh)
            else context.forEachSuccessor(node) { deliverAt(it, premise, fresh) }
        }
    }

    private fun admitOutput(node: CommonInst, premise: PremiseKey, facts: Facts): List<Facts> {
        if (!RuntimeDataDomain.packet(premise, facts)) return emptyList()
        checkKinds(premise, facts)
        return edges.addAll(node, premise, facts).also { deltas ->
            for (fresh in deltas) {
                bodyWork?.fresh(context.shared.language.getInstIndex(node), premise, fresh)
                localEdgeDeltas++
                if (fresh.layer == Layer.DEMAND) localDemandLayerEdges++
            }
        }
    }

    private fun deliverAt(start: CommonInst, premise: PremiseKey, facts: Facts) {
        rootRouting?.let { it.enter(start, premise, facts); return }
        context.forEachDeliveryTarget(start, facts.base) { enqueueInput(it, premise, facts) }
    }

    internal fun enqueueInput(node: CommonInst, premise: PremiseKey, facts: Facts) {
        if (!RuntimeDataDomain.packet(premise, facts)) return
        checkKinds(premise, facts)
        worklist.add(EdgeDelta(premise, node, facts))
        requestWork()
    }

    internal fun checkPremise(premise: PremiseKey) {
        check(!config.run1 || premise is InitialAp) { "Run-1 executable edges have one original premise" }
    }

    internal fun checkKinds(premise: PremiseKey, facts: Facts) {
        checkPremise(premise)
        check((facts is FlowTree) == premise.isFlow) { "K6: the conclusion kind follows its premise" }
        check(premise !is PremiseSet || facts is TaintTree) { "A multi-premise edge must be TAINT" }
        if (config.run1) when (facts) {
            is FlowTree -> check(facts.exclusion == ExclusionSet.Empty) { "Run-1 FLOW has Empty field E" }
            is TaintTree -> check(facts.exclusion == ExclusionSet.Empty) { "Run-1 TAINT has Empty field E" }
            is Reach -> Unit
        }
    }

    internal open fun requestWork() {
        if (binding != null) binding.schedule() else runnerPort.enqueue(this as RunMethodAnalyzer)
    }

    internal fun nextStaticTicket(): Long = binding?.staticTicket() ?: ++lastStaticTicket
    private var lastStaticTicket = 0L

    private inner class RuleWorklist(
        private val rules: RuleStatement,
        private val node: CommonInst,
        private val point: Cut,
    ) {
        private val items = LinkedHashMap<Pair<PremiseKey, Facts>, RuleItem>()
        private val add: ResultSink = { premise, facts ->
            cut(point, premise, facts) { pr, result ->
                val key = pr to result
                val old = items[key]
                val merged = if (old == null) result else ap.mergeAddDelta(old.facts, result).first
                items[key] = RuleItem(pr, merged)
            }
        }

        fun input(premise: PremiseKey, facts: Facts) {
            applier.statement(rules.summary, premise, facts, Place(node, config.run1, sources = true,
                site = ResumeSite.BoundaryInput(operation(node), point == Cut.ENTRY_RULES)), sink = add)
        }

        fun drain(after: (PremiseKey, Facts, Triggers) -> Unit = { _, _, _ -> }) {
            for (item in items.values) {
                ap.cancellation.checkpoint()
                val premise = item.premise; val facts = item.facts
                val triggers = localServices.checkSinksAt(premise, node, facts, rules.sinks,
                    OperationInput(ResumeSite.BoundaryInput(operation(node), point == Cut.ENTRY_RULES), premise, facts))
                after(premise, facts, triggers)
            }
        }

        fun forEachResult(visit: (PremiseKey, Facts) -> Unit) {
            for (item in items.values) { visit(item.premise, item.facts) }
        }
    }

    internal fun startAt(premise: PremiseKey, node: CommonInst, start: Facts,
                         deliver: (PremiseKey, Facts) -> Unit = { pr, value ->
                             binding?.startResult(this, node, pr, value) ?: deliverAt(node, pr, value) }) {
        if (!RuntimeDataDomain.packet(premise, start)) return
        forms.withStartRules(key, node) { rules ->
            val work = RuleWorklist(rules, node,
                if (forward) Cut.ENTRY_RULES else Cut.EXIT_RULES)
            work.input(premise, start)
            if (!forward && premise.isZero) localServices.fireSinkSeeds(node) { seed -> work.input(ap.zero, seed) }
            work.drain()
            work.forEachResult { pr, facts ->
                ap.cancellation.checkpoint()
                if (config.run1 && facts.base == STATIC) return@forEachResult
                deliver(pr, facts)
            }
        }
    }

    internal fun endAt(premise: PremiseKey, node: CommonInst, facts: Facts, summary: Boolean) {
        if (!RuntimeDataDomain.packet(premise, facts)) return
        if (config.run1 && summary) checkNotNull(staticWriteCandidates).observe(premise, facts)
        forms.withEndRules(key, node) { exit ->
            val work = RuleWorklist(exit.rules, node, if (forward) Cut.EXIT_RULES else Cut.ENTRY_RULES)
            work.input(premise, facts)
            work.drain { pr, value, triggers ->
                if (!summary) {
                    // Exceptional rules and observations still run, but normal
                    // summary adjustment and killed-write guidance do not.
                    for (fresh in admitOutput(node, pr, value))
                        if (binding != null) retainBlockSummary(PortId(-4), pr, fresh)
                    return@drain
                }
                if (config.run1) checkNotNull(staticWriteCandidates).observe(pr, value)
                // Local span rows include the real boundary rules. G2 and entry-mark
                // metadata use the complete method origin after parent binding.
                val result = if (isRootScope) finishMethodData(ops, mode, pr, value, exit, triggers.parts) else value
                result?.let { completed ->
                    boundedSummaryResult(pr, completed) { boundedPremise, bounded ->
                        for (fresh in admitOutput(node, boundedPremise, bounded))
                            retainSummary(boundedPremise, fresh, binding?.terminalExit ?: PortId.ROOT_EXIT)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /** Complete method-origin metadata only. The real boundary rules already ran in a leaf. */
    internal fun finishBoundMethodBoundary(premise: PremiseKey, node: CommonInst, value: Facts, summary: Boolean) {
        if (!summary) return
        if (config.run1) checkNotNull(staticWriteCandidates).observe(premise, value)
        forms.withEndRules(key, node) { exit ->
            adjustMethodExitMetadata(premise, value, exit)?.let { summaryDelta(premise, it) }
        }

# ANY initial emission: source inventory and STAR assessment

Status: source audit only, 7 November 2026. No implementation, test/model
execution or project run. The user requested an inventory and assessment;
this note does not select a replacement policy. Source pins, snippets and
the constructor/start call-site ledger are in `inventory.json`.

Scope is the current BIDI `InitialAp`/`Tail` runtime. The older IFDS
`InitialFactAp` hierarchy is a different domain. A Facts tail, demand template,
summary premise, transient inverse read, interned key and actual entry command
are distinct. “Creates an initial” below means a native producer whose value
reaches `BlockRunState.addInitial`, or an explicitly identified operation-local
resume. Generic factories/channels can accept caller-supplied keys; that is
not another native ANY emitter.

## 1. The two central ANY cells

Write demand path p and actual path q. Both cells are in
`ap/RestrictedInitialPolicy.kt:30–35,56–61`:

| Cell | Conditions after common guards | Emitted key | Marks / layer |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| E1, same head | p=q; demand tail ANY; actual tail ANY | demand base, p, ANY, Empty E | Eligible FLOW or full concrete mark; DEMAND |
| E2, demand below actual head | p strictly extends q; actual admits p−q; demand tail ANY; actual tail ANY | demand base, p, ANY, Empty E | Same; DEMAND |

These are all `result(..., Tail.ANY)` branches in this policy. In both,
the actual already has MAY/ANY. Neither cell converts a STAR actual to ANY.
Same-head demand ANY + actual STAR currently rejects. Changing E1/E2 results
does **not** change that rejected cell, which was the earlier separate question.

The configured callers use these cells in every restricted run (run >=2),
both directions. There is no forward-only, nonempty-path or run-2-only guard
on E1/E2. Actual ANY facts have DEMAND layer in the native domain. Emitted ANY
also has intrinsic DEMAND, independently of a supplied layer.

Common guards and legal-output checks remain material:

* `validDemand`, then `normalizeDemandFieldExclusion`; equal base and
  `markSub(required,actual,catalog)`; ZERO actual must be canonical.
* Counted depth of both normalized demand and actual must fit fieldLimit.
  E2 can select a deeper demand head, but it still must fit this bound.
* FLOW demand can accept eligible FLOW or concrete actuals and emits plain
  FLOW with empty mark exclusion. Concrete demand needs a concrete actual
  covered by its declared mark. A GROUP demand can bind the actual full atom;
  a concrete GROUP output is rejected by `legalInitial`.
* An output ANY has Empty E; it cannot carry holes. `legalInitial` forbids
  excluded FLOW output marks and malformed ZERO. Runtime admission rejects
  literal/Constant bases. Run-1 validation is a separate, narrower grammar.
* Concrete STATIC output is legal only at a named field anchor (class then
  field, optional suffix). A class-only concrete marker is EXACT, not ANY.
  FLOW STATIC has the policy's broader abstract grammar. Run-2 concrete FULL
  actual validation separately checks named fields, counted budget, allowed
  EXACT/ANY/STAR tails and E; it rejects backward MUST and broad class/root
  concrete actuals. Local block inputs rely on their already-bounded native
  pipeline; they do not call the method-call wrapper's input validator anew.

`ANY_TAINT` is **MUST**, not MAY/ANY. Keep it separate. The same-head and
ancestor-MUST actual cells can emit MUST, with their existing E rules, only
when the output passes the forward-only MUST legality check. No replacement
of MUST or its support-layer behavior is implied here.

## 2. Actual native start paths

| Path / owner | Producer and consumer | Can natively start ANY? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Restricted resolved method call | `RunMethodCallServices.enterCallees` → limit actual → `DemandStore.initials` → `InitialDemandResults.offer` → E1/E2 → `RunnerPort.startInitials` → `InitialsIn` → actor `addInitial` | Yes, central E1/E2 |
| Restricted block / loop / empty interface | `MethodBlockRuntime.offerChild` → physical `BlockBoundaryDemandView.admission` → scoped `DemandStore.initials` → E1/E2 → child state `addInitial` | Yes, central E1/E2; same rule for adjacent/repeat entries |
| Run-2 static completion / shared carry | Local entry trie, `staticCarry`, `StaticEntryLookup.directLocal/search` → the **same** `InitialDemandResults.offer` | Yes, only through E1/E2; no alternate static tail emitter |
| Method root / `addRootZero` | R1 canonical ZERO; restricted `emitRestrictedInitials(...Reach.NORMAL)` → typed control lookup → `existingZeroAdmission` | No: ZERO/EXACT/NORMAL only |
| Backward call ZERO | `zeroAtCall` → Reach control admission → same ZERO command | No. Its separate sink-seed DATA stream can later enter the ordinary call path above |
| R1 ordinary raw method call | `LinkIn` → `Run1Abstraction.emit` → `policyInitial` / requested concrete answers → `addInitial` | No: abstract base STAR, concrete EXACT/STAR, or ZERO |
| R1 local block / loop input | Local abstraction uses the same R1 emitter | No; R1 validation explicitly rejects ANY and MUST initial tails |
| R1 late concrete request answer | `forEachConcreteAnswer` → `InitialAnswersIn` or synchronous abstraction answer → `addInitial` | No: exact root branch EXACT; every other answer STAR; Empty E |
| Existing initial reaches another real reverse predecessor | `offerChild` iterates `state.initials.admissions`, rebuilds its start fact and queues `startEntryTarget` | Can restart an **existing** ANY; creates no new key/tail |
| R1 physical static read / mark reply | `Run1PointResume.onEffect` → explicit abstract field STAR or `concreteStaticResumeInitial` → `installPoint` | No ANY key. Resumed Facts may have ANY; operation-local, not method-entry seeding |
| R1 static local boundary / write shortcut | `LocalStaticInputRequests`, `offerStaticAnswer`, `routeStaticBoundaryInput` → concrete EXACT/STAR or explicit FLOW STAR → actual point/boundary resume | No ANY key; preserve the actual supplied Facts and scope |
| R1 supplied static call composition | `applyCanonicalStaticInput` chooses concrete EXACT/STAR and composes the existing summary | No ANY key or new callee entry command |
| Complete provider/predefined method | `CallStage.Predefined` applies edges directly; UnitRunner prohibits its actor/subscription | No actor initial. Provider edges can produce ANY Facts |
| Source / sink / trigger seed | AP transfer or `seedFact`, with existing original or ZERO, enters normal instruction/call flow | Facts, not a new initial emitter; later callee/block starts use the paths above |

`BlockBoundaryDemandView`'s backward exceptional-interface HACK borrows normal
control rows only for Reach. It adds no DATA/ANY admission alias. Root/block
scope, actual physical interface and complete caller original remain distinct.

Method-call emission bounds actuals before querying; DemandStore canonicalizes
the bounded packet and visits its actual leaves. Block entries receive values
from existing boundary cut paths. Canonicalization/limiting can create or keep
ANY **facts**, which then select E1/E2; they are not an alternative entry-key
emitter. Saved NORMAL replay runs before live C2 admission but applies a record
to the offered input; it does not create a new actor initial.

## 3. Factories and query paths which must not be counted as starts

* `ApManager.initial` is an unrestricted interner. `InitialAp` is constructed
  only there. The factory can represent ANY/MUST; it does not schedule work.
* `RunEvent.InitialsIn`, `InitialAnswersIn` and `addInitial` transport/accept
  completed commands. Restricted `addInitial` does not re-run C2; it checks
  domain, backward-MUST legality and layer/seen admission. A custom caller
  could inject an ANY key. Reviewed native producers are the table above.
* `ApOps.emit`/`emitInitials` and the scalar reference `emit` share this policy,
  but no additional production actor-start caller was found. The former can
  intern query answers; the historical `referenceRequestAction` is explicitly
  oracle-only and has no runtime event/consumer.
* `LoopConsumerObservation`, `LoopAdmissionBundle`, `LoopQueryScratch` and
  `LoopRestrictionSession` query the same C2 image for observations/certificates.
  Their returned keys do not start actors. They are semantic consumers of any
  proposed policy change, even though they are not entry producers.
* `NeutralRelationBatch`, diagonal/flow-backed decoding, killed static writer
  keys and flow-summary normalization create/reuse **summary premise keys**.
  They do not call `addInitial`. FLOW summary normalization maps EXACT to STAR;
  it does not map ANY to STAR. Opposite-record MUST views are transient Patterns,
  not interned/started initial commands. ND originals combine existing member
  keys; they are not an independent tail emitter.

## 4. Image, start layer and C5 must be assessed together

Current `canEmitInitial` has same-head images EXACT, ANY, MUST and requested
R2 STAR. Its ANY image is `d.tail==ANY`, at the demand head. E2's emitted path
is also that demand head, so it needs no separate image branch. Deeper emitted
first-field STAR/EXACT images are distinct from E1/E2.

`canStoreInitial` is **not** just raw-image membership. It requires
`canEmitInitial(raw) && insideDemand(raw,entry)`, and additionally accepts a
FLOW STAR/Empty-E stored key when its raw EXACT preimage passes. That fallback
exists because whole FLOW summary normalization converts EXACT to STAR.
Concrete STAR has no such EXACT-preimage fallback.

C5 uses that contract in the native `restrict` path, complete static pair
lookup and Target/control entry checks. Prepared output programs obtain their
capability through `EntryRestrictionTicket.prepare`, which calls the same
`canStoreInitial`. Exact paired exit, whole ND original, physical scope and
per-exit field budget still apply; an entry-image update does not authorize
another exit. A local raw-emitter replacement must update its exact image and
the storage/preimage model consistently, including stale ANY image removal.

| Existing E1/E2 output | Current start | Replace key with STAR and recompute current policy | Preserve old supplied DEMAND explicitly |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ANY/FLOW | ANY/FLOW DEMAND | STAR/FLOW NORMAL | STAR/FLOW DEMAND (distinct command/layer choice) |
| ANY/full-T | ANY/T DEMAND | STAR/T DEMAND | STAR/T DEMAND |

`admissionLayer` ignores supplied support for FLOW and uses the intrinsic tail
policy. `initialFacts`, `canonicalAdmission`, `InitialFactStore` and
`BlockRunState.addInitial` enforce intrinsic layers independently. Therefore
changing only the raw tail normally promotes FLOW entry to NORMAL; keeping
DEMAND needs an explicit consistent layer rule, not an assumption that old
support survives. Summary/caller layer joins still apply on replay, so this
table alone does not prove a new final NORMAL finding or a false confirmation.

Initial keys/commands contain no protection mask. The complete actual Facts,
its mask and caller/link layer stay on the subscription or local link; budget
and query adapters must preserve their existing behavior. Replacing a key is
not permission to rewrite those facts, literal H coordinates or owner metadata.

STAR also changes matching/transfer behavior even if DEMAND is kept. The
`applicable` predicate treats ANY initial tails differently from STAR. Symbolic
field transfer, stored NORMAL availability, Target eligibility, selected handoff
and deduplication can change. Current sink witnesses distinguish NORMAL from
DEMAND; facts/initial equality need not change for those effects to change.

The shared loop certificate has a concrete dependency: after scalar emission
it requires an ANY/DEMAND witness (`LoopRestrictionSession:50–54`). Replacing
both ANY cells with STAR makes that witness fail its current guard and fall
back to native trials. Conversely, rewriting only delivered actor keys leaves
read-only C2 observation signatures inconsistent with actual entry commands.
Neither is a harmless spelling substitution.

## 5. History is evidence of intent, not a rollback proof

Before `c347ff8bb74e78062c3ae8162c8a0e9a2074f398` (parent `515677019`),
`Reference.emit` handled a FLOW entry as:

```kotlin
if (entry.fact.mark == MarkSlot.STAR)
    return if (overlap(entry, actual)) flowForm(entry) else null
```

That `flowForm` converted an ANY entry to STAR/Empty-E. Concrete entries used
`commonPart`, which could still emit ANY. Thus FLOW STAR admission is not
historically unprecedented, but a universal no-ANY initial rule was not the
old contract. c347 introduced restricted refinement, including the two ANY
result cells and same-head ANY/STAR rejection. Current `flowForm` remains as
an orphan definition; the live emitter does not call it.

Old overlap also accepted cases rejected now. Replacing only today's ANY
results would not restore that whole policy. Current legal image, inside/C5
checks, summary matching roles, support layers and owner/port handling must
be assessed in their current context. Historical use proves neither current
candidate safety nor authorization to roll back those other rules.

## 6. Bounded assessment, not a selection

A coherent replacement design must decide both cells, FLOW and concrete,
both directions, root/nonempty/static coordinates, and the layer table above.
It must refine raw emission image, normalized storage image and read-only loop
observation together. It must preserve or explicitly revise the required
source/sink and progress effects through native C5, saved/current/opposite
summary roles, ND and labelled physical ports. No global DATA confluence or
mere denotational inclusion establishes that result.

The existing OWASP storage-cycle test documents coarse ANY creation from
STAR field reads and checks refinement under an actual uniform MUST source.
Its unchanged MUST input does not by itself test these two ANY-actual cells.
The previous counterexample for admitting an actual STAR under ANY demand
cannot be imported as a proof for this different replacement. Termination,
finding preservation and project impact remain proof/native obligations;
no new test, model or project result is claimed by this inventory.

# ANY initial to STAR: semantic candidate audit, 7 November 2026

Status: source/captured-evidence audit only. No policy is selected. The preparer
ran no JVM, Gradle, compiler, Lean checker or analyzer and changed no repository
file. The traces below are explicit evaluations of current native source cells,
or clearly labeled counterfactuals. They are not new runtime observations.

## Candidate definitions

Let `F` be the abstract FLOW mark, `T` one full concrete mark, `N/D` the two
layers, `$` EXACT, `A` ANY, `S` STAR and `M/E` ANY_TAINT with exclusion E.
All converted ANY cells have Empty E. Initial keys have no layer; the entry
command `AdmittedInitial(P, layer)` supplies it.

| Candidate | Changed geometry | Entry layer for a converted key |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1: geometry only | Existing emitted `p.A/m` becomes `p.S/m` | Preserve the existing admitted D layer |
| 2: intrinsic layer | Same conversion | Recompute from converted key: F/S becomes N; T/S remains D |
| 3F: FLOW-only | Apply 1 or 2 only when the rendered mark is F | State explicitly whether D is preserved or recomputed |
| 3All: full mark too | Also convert rendered T | Subject to the concrete C5 and protected-header issues below |

Candidate 2 here recomputes layers only for the converted ANY outputs. Resetting
layers on **all** C2 outputs is a further change: it would also erase the current
DEMAND support/loss bit on concrete EXACT emitted from a MAY actual. That broader
change is not silently included.

`BlockRunState.startInitial` starts the intrinsic fact, then ORs its layer with
`admitted.layer == DEMAND` (lines 257–258). Thus candidate 1 really can start
FLOW/S in D while retaining S. `canonicalAdmission` also preserves supplied D.
Using just `startFact(newKey)` instead implements candidate 2 for FLOW, not 1.

## Exactly which current C2 outputs change

For legal normalized demand `d=(b,p,A,m)` and legal actual `a=(b,q,A,n)`, with
the native mark match, path budget and base tests satisfied:

| Relation of paths | Current emitted key | Candidate key |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `q=p` | `(b,p,A,renderedMark)` | `(b,p,S,renderedMark)` |
| `p` strictly below `q` (actual above demand) | `(b,p,A,renderedMark)` | `(b,p,S,renderedMark)` |

The actual is D by W6; current ANY emission is D. The rendered mark is F for a
FLOW demand, or the required full mark for a compatible concrete demand.
These are the two ANY-output cells in `RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit`.

The following cells do **not** change under a post-map of existing ANY outputs:

- ANY demand + same-head STAR actual still rejects. No output exists to map.
- ANY demand + same-head concrete EXACT actual still emits EXACT with its native
  support layer. ANY demand + same-head MUST emits MUST in forward mode.
- Actual strictly below ANY demand still uses the first new counted field,
  yielding the existing STAR or exact-concrete cell, not ANY.
- EXACT demand + MAY actual still emits provisional EXACT, with D support.
- Canonical ZERO remains its existing EXACT/zero-mark key and N command. It is
  not an ANY-to-STAR case. Static class anchors and named static fields retain
  their separate native grammar; a bare class marker cannot be generalized.

## Hard local incompatibility: emission image and paired C5

For either changed cell the new key is at the demand's own path. Current
`canEmitInitial(d.A, p.S)` is **false**, for F and T, in every run. Its same-path
STAR image accepts only run-2 demand STAR with matching E, counted depth strictly
less than the limit, and the static-anchor guard. This is not the ANY row.

Current `canStoreInitial(d.A, p.S/F)` can nevertheless be true: its separate
FLOW normalization fallback tests a raw `p.$/F` preimage. That preimage can be in
the emitter image and inside the demand. This deliberately supports normalized
EXACT/FLOW summaries. It does not prove that the newly proposed STAR emission
has a valid preimage from this actual MAY, or that its new start relation/layer
is sound.

There is **no** analogous concrete fallback. The paired row which accepts
`p.A/T` rejects proposed `p.S/T` in current `canStoreInitial`. `restrict`,
prepared entry capabilities, and `DemandStore.acceptsTarget` call this predicate.
A post-map of emitter output alone therefore breaks a producer/consumer
contract. Another demand row can sometimes admit the same new key; this local
counterexample does not prove a complete program loses every route.

### A real code/rule shape for that local counterexample

```java
// All objects initialized. Configured pass rule for put:
// value.*/F -> bag.[any]/F (AnyField target, not a uniform source).
v = sourceExactT();
bag.put(unknownKey, v);
y = id(bag);
sinkAnyT(y);

id(q) { return q; }
```

Source rule: `ZERO.$/0 -> v.$/T`. Sink rule: `y.[any]/T`. The ordinary configured
AnyField pass is permitted by S15; no summary is supplied for `id`.

```text
source                         v.$/T N
AnyField put pass               bag.A/T D  (W6; unknown output field)
bind-in                        q.A/T D
sink-induced backward demand    q.A/T -> ret.A/T
current C2                     P=q.A/T, admitted D
current start; ordinary return q.A/T D -> ret.A/T D
current paired C5               canStoreInitial(q.A/T, P)=true

candidate 1/2 full-mark key     P'=q.S/T, admitted D
new start; ordinary return     q.S/T D -> ret.S/T D
unchanged paired C5            canStoreInitial(q.A/T, P')=false
```

The return relation is derived from `MicroEdgeBuilder.move(ret,q)` and its
native STAR/FLOW transport edge. It is not an invented predefined summary.
The sink-to-demand chain is a source-defined local obligation; a complete
driver execution of this new program has not been run. What is proved from
source is the displayed emitter/image/C5 mismatch for those actual operands,
not an end-to-end FN. Fixing `canEmit/canStore` is necessary to evaluate the
candidate rather than this inconsistent partial patch.

## Correlation: input-domain equality is not output-relation equality

With Empty E, ANY and STAR premises both admit every input suffix sigma.
Their initial **conclusions** differ:

```text
P=q.A/T -> start q.A/T D: arbitrary output tau (independent of sigma)
P=q.S/T -> start q.S/T D: output tau=sigma
```

The selected correlated-concrete spec explicitly treats this as a semantic
change, not a constructor rewrite. It also says a STAR concrete input does not
assert T at every descendant. A strict subset of an old approximation is not
by itself a lost-real-path counterexample. Conversely, equal premise location
sets do not prove all new transfer/replay/driver obligations.

### Ordinary write establishes the suffix relation

```java
shift(q) { Box out = initializedBox(); out.f = q; return out; }
// Source: exact T on q at the caller. Sink controls: out.f vs out.f.g.
```

Native write edge: `q.S/F -> out.f.S/F`.

```text
old start q.A/T D -> out.f.A/T D
new start q.S/T D -> out.f.S/T D

for a concrete input suffix sigma=[]:   new output out.f.$/T
for a concrete input suffix sigma=[g]:  new output out.f.g.$/T
there is no new implication [] -> [g]
```

The last two lines are the meaning of the relation when applied to those actual
inputs, not NORMAL facts emitted by a D summary. A field-limit cut can still
make the actual result MAY/D. This example is a correlation/precision control;
it is not a proof that the blanket replacement is correct.

## Actual matching: do not conflate C2 with summary reads

Current `Summary.satisfyingPart` retains selected actual leaves and their layer.
For the copy-derived summaries above, with the same Empty-E head:

| Actual | ANY premise | STAR premise | Important limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| MAY/D | Selected; remains MAY/D | Selected; remains MAY/D | New key does not turn the actual into STAR or MUST |
| STAR/Empty E | Already allowed AT via insidePart | Allowed AT via applicable/inside | C2's ANY/STAR rejection is a different operation |
| Concrete EXACT at/below head | ANY cannot use applicable on an exact actual; inside must still hold | STAR can use applicable with the actual suffix | A changed match domain alone proves neither FP nor required-path loss |
| Uniform MUST | Native uniform leaves can be selected | Native uniform leaves can be selected | Keep their actual tail/E/layer; do not reinterpret MAY as uniform |

CURRENT and SAVED_DIRECT forbid selecting a **strict-ancestor STAR** actual
through `insidePart`. OPPOSITE_RECORD permits that existing native case.
This role rule is not relaxed by renaming an initial. ANY and STAR premises can
both read a same-head Empty-E STAR actual through existing paths. A note which
says ANY premises never match STAR actuals would be wrong.

## Intrinsic FLOW layer changes normal-record availability

Use actual ordinary code `id(q) { return q; }`, with the put-generated MAY input
and source/sink rules from the first example. Assume the required paired-entry
image update is made; otherwise the preceding partial-patch mismatch dominates.

| Variant | Started FLOW fact | Derived return | Eligible NORMAL record? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Current | q.A/F D | ret.A/F D | No |
| Candidate 1 | q.S/F D | ret.S/F D | No |
| Candidate 2 | q.S/F N | ret.S/F N | Yes, subject to existing owner/record guards |

This is a real layer/record-policy change even though the micro edge is the
same ordinary move. It is not proved to be an FP: that parametric copy relation
can be valid for every actual suffix. FLOW origins cannot directly emit Targets
(`BlockRunState.emitTarget`). `LocalRelationApplication.targetArmLayer` also
requires actual/offered NORMAL support before applying a NormalTarget. In
particular, an original caller MAY/D is not made NORMAL simply because the
summary was derived with an N seed. No complete false-NORMAL-report example has
been established by this audit. The new normal-record and future-read workload,
progress and report behavior still need proof and native tests.

### Actual captured getG and a source-derived counterfactual

The Nov6 five-snapshot capture is actual evidence, not this audit's run:
`ret.A/F -> arg.g.A/F D` is B2 getG's sole public summary, with three processed
DEMAND facts and no scoped summary. Before F3, getG has only two FORWARD public
NORMAL records: ZERO identity and argument-root STAR/FLOW identity. There is no
BACKWARD getG record and no getG return conclusion.

The body is ordinary `getG(q) { return q.g; }`. Its forward edge
`arg.g.S/F -> ret.S/F` reverses natively to `ret.S/F -> arg.g.S/F`.
Counterfactual candidate 2 in B2 gives:

```text
converted initial ret.S/F N
backward ordinary read        arg.g.S/F N
output counted depth=1, limit=1: no cut (strict > limit only)
possible persisted BACKWARD   ret.S/F -> arg.g.S/F N
native opposite F3 view       arg.g.S/F -> ret.S/F N
```

All shown edges come from the getter body and native reversal. This can create
a saved-return route which is absent in the captured run. Candidate 1 keeps D
and cannot persist that same NORMAL record. This is not a new runtime result or
a proof that candidate 2 recovers the full loop program. Native opposite-read
constructor, matching role, actual support, C5 and physical owner checks remain.

## Exact T is not descendant T; MUST is not unknown MAY

These are required negative controls with actual source/sink rules:

```java
q = sourceExactT(); // ZERO.$/0 -> q.$/T
sinkExactT(q);     // positive root control
r = q.f;
sinkExactT(r);     // no T descendant follows from the source rule
```

The read edge `q.f.S/F -> r.S/F` cannot read the strict ancestor `q.$/T`:
`Reference.above` rejects EXACT. Also, ANY demand + same-head exact actual emits
EXACT, not ANY; the proposed two-cell conversion does not touch this input.
Do not present a universal STAR tail as meaning uniform T at descendants.

```java
q = sourceUniformT(); // ZERO.$/0 -> q.M/T N; S15 source, all admitted descendants T
r = q.f;
sinkExactT(r);       // native uniform read can retain NORMAL support
```

Current C2 ANY/MUST emits MUST in a forward run, with native E and actual
support. A policy which only removes ANY initials leaves this cell unchanged.
Replacing MUST as well would be a different proposal and could discard uniform
support. An unknown AnyField pass output, in contrast, is MAY/D and supplies no
such uniform NORMAL evidence. A full-mark STAR seed is D in both candidates.

## Concrete negative workload construction: optional strong overwrites

This is source-validated, not yet a measured native comparison. It applies
directly to full-mark conversion; FLOW-only conversion leaves the concrete ANY/T
cell unchanged. All local objects/fields exist. `cleanRootT` is a selected T
EXACT-root cleaner. Each `fi` is a distinct named counted field. Null writes
are native strong writes, not cleaners invented to manufacture summaries.

```java
v = sourceExactT();
bag.put(unknownKey, v);       // configured AnyField pass -> bag.A/T D
consume(bag);

consume(q) {
    cleanRootT(q);           // selected T, EXACT at q, not all descendants
    if (c1) q.f1 = null;
    if (c2) q.f2 = null;
    // ... independently optional, unrolled through fN
    sinkAnyT(q);             // same source/sink rule family; no injected initial
}
```

At a local store reached after joining these branches:

```text
current admitted q.A/T D
  EXACT-root clean -> q.A/T D H, E={}
  strong keep /{fi} -> q.A/T D H, E={}  (ANY clears E)
  all branch subsets collapse to the same typed MAY header

converted admitted q.S/T D
  EXACT-root clean -> q.S/T D H, E={}
  strong keep /{fi} -> q.S/T D H, E=oldE union {fi}
  after k optional fields: H spans for every E subset of {f1,...,fk}
```

Source chain: `ApOps.clean` wraps surviving selected T with protection;
`Clean.TaintClean.cut` handles EXACT-root PART by emitting the same tail in D.
`strongKeep` makes a STAR identity edge with E={fi}. `EdgeApplication.taint`
unions E for a same-head STAR result; its ANY result is emitted with Empty E.
`transportProtection` applies the same transfer to H. Finally the selected H
law retains each original span tail/E, even when ordinary DATA joins E down to
Empty. Thus one scalar position/full mark can require 2^k typed protected STAR/E
headers in this branch family, instead of one MAY header.

For k=2 the explicit H header set is
`{ S/{}, S/{f1}, S/{f2}, S/{f1,f2} }`; no new H flag is inferred from overlap.
The cleaner introduces the selected H; writes transport it. The candidate does
not need to change the H contract to enable this cost difference. Returning to
prefix-subsuming protected spans to hide the family would violate the selected
contract, not optimize the same algorithm.

This is a conditional source-derived family construction. A bounded native
AP/group comparison must establish the actual counts and delta carriers for
both starts before a driver/workload claim. The current concrete C5 mismatch
must be addressed separately; local store growth can occur before summary C5.
The already verified MUST primer mechanism is analogous evidence only, not a
runtime result for this new STAR-vs-MAY candidate. No project slowdown or FP/FN
is attributed to this unrun variant.

## Field-limit boundary, nested call and progress limits

STAR at counted length exactly L passes `legalInitial`'s `<= L` budget. This
does not establish emitter-image membership, whose current same-head STAR row
has separate guards. A later write/read can increase an applied path beyond L;
`limit` then emits prefix ANY/D and clears E. Removing ANY **initials** does not
remove MAY **facts**, required guide coordinates, or field cuts.

```java
outer(q) { return getG(q); }
getG(r) { return r.g; }
// Actual enclosing MAY/FLOW at q; native demand at getG is r.A/F.
```

Candidate 1 converts the outer MAY initial to q.S/F D. The outer bind-in gives
the inner call r.S/F D. The unchanged inner C2 ANY-demand/STAR-actual cell still
returns null; it emits nothing that can be post-mapped. Candidate 2 has the
same tail issue, although a new opposite NORMAL record might bypass it.
Without a suitable saved return route or another actual/initial, a two-cell
replacement alone does not ensure inner admission. This is a conditional local
pipeline obstruction, not a complete new program failure: saved-first replay,
other contexts and later iterations must be checked rather than assumed absent.

Every proposed policy must re-establish the emitter image, paired C5/Target
entry tests, native summary read roles, admitted layers, exact original/scope/
ports and loop-observation certificates. A changed initial key can merge with
an existing STAR key; initial D/N seen bits and support must still distinguish
commands. Literal H and selected MAY guide positions are separate contracts.
Finite bounded keys do not prove useful refinement, natural stopping, faster
execution or a complete report. No termination, universal refinement, FP or
full-program FN theorem is claimed here.

## Required bounded native gate, owned by root

Test the two C2 changed cells for F/T and candidates 1/2; exact/STAR/MUST and
ZERO controls; at/below/strict-ancestor matching under CURRENT, SAVED_DIRECT and
OPPOSITE_RECORD; the copy/shift derived body; paired concrete C5 rejection and
the FLOW normalization preimage; the B2 ordinary-getG opposite record; exact
depth=L and depth>L cuts; and the optional-overwrite family for small k. Keep
actual source/sink rules, full original, layer, tail/E, H, scopes and native
fallbacks in the receipt. Then compare any selected complete policy through
the real small driver, including alternate saved routes and natural convergence.

No scripts in this directory launch those gates. `audit.json` labels each
claim and `source-pins.json` binds the reviewed source/captured evidence.

# Conditional native AP/store gate — prepared, not executed

Root must first obtain the new formal model/checker PASS. Previous project and
reader jobs are terminal per root. The preparer has launched no job. These five
tests do not override production C2 and do not inject a real program initial.

Cases: candidate-layer choice; current emitter/image and paired-C5 mismatch;
ordinary reversed getter producing an actual persisted row and native opposite
MAY read; selected EXACT-root cleaner plus five optional ordinary strong writes
(one MAY H header versus 32 STAR/E H headers); and the unchanged inner ANY/STAR
rejection in a conditional wrapper. The getter summaries come from
`MicroEdgeBuilder.read(...).build().reversed()` and native summary/persistence
operations. H comes only from `ops.clean`; no test calls `withProtection`.
The MAY/T actual comes from an exact-T source edge and a legal AnyField pass.

```sh

  '-Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2g -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2' \

```

The property is root's declaration of the formal/terminal gate, not an automated
proof or process check. The init creates one separate external source set and
one Test task, with native main/test dependencies. It adds no runtime overlay,
provider or production source file. Native `testClasses` may compile as a
dependency but are not executed by this task. Worker: one fork, 1 GiB, one CPU;
Gradle: 2 GiB, two CPUs, one worker, Kotlin in process. Task timeout: 60 seconds.

Source pins are checked before compile/test and in the finalizer. Runtime
classpath bytes are fingerprinted only by root after compilation, in the new
`output/root-execution-started.json`; no old receipt is updated. Only the unique
test class family may appear in external compiled output. A start receipt
prevents an automatic second execution; no retry, process scan or signal exists.

Complete test stdout is `output/test-output.log`; all 26 bounded JSON trace
events, if every assertion succeeds, are copied to `output/typed-traces.jsonl`.
They retain actual mark IDs/logical names, native leaves, layers, typed field
paths/E and root H. XML is under `output/xml`, with HTML and binary results in
separate external paths. The finalizer labels failures/incomplete evidence and
records counts/hashes in `output/root-evidence.json`; Gradle retains its exit.

not select a new policy or prove full native matching equivalence, a real lost
path, false-positive report, universal refinement/termination, program recovery
or project performance. Root owns execution handles and interpretation.

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.driver

import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.MethodWithContext
import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.ResolvedPrescanGraph
import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.TaintAnalysisManager
import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.TaintAnalysisUnitRunnerManager
import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.trace.VulnerabilityWithTrace
import kotlin.time.Duration

interface BidiEntry {
    fun gather(manager: TaintAnalysisManager, startMethods: List<MethodWithContext>)
    fun gather(manager: TaintAnalysisManager, startMethods: List<MethodWithContext>, graph: ResolvedPrescanGraph) =
        gather(manager, startMethods)
    fun run(budget: Duration): Report
    fun toVulnerabilities(report: Report): List<VulnerabilityWithTrace>
    fun status(report: Report): TaintAnalysisUnitRunnerManager.Status
}

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine

import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.AccessPathBase
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.graph.PortId
import org.opentaint.ir.api.common.cfg.CommonInst

/** Explicit owner services for one local entry. No callback selects an active block. */
internal interface BlockRuntimeBinding {
    val scope: BlockScope
    val context: RunMethodContext
    val points: PointDirectory<CommonInst>
    val bodyWork: BodyWorkStatistics?
    val sourceHits: SourceHitStore?
    val sinkSeeds: LinkedHashSet<org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.driver.Seed>
    val demand: ScopeDemandView?
    val terminalExit: PortId get() = if (context.config.direction == Direction.FORWARD)
        PortId.ROOT_EXIT else PortId.ROOT_ENTRY
    fun schedule()
    fun start(state: BlockRunState, original: InitialAp, value: Facts)
    fun startResult(state: BlockRunState, node: CommonInst, original: PremiseKey, value: Facts)
    fun successors(state: BlockRunState, node: CommonInst, original: PremiseKey, value: Facts)
    fun publish(state: BlockRunState, exit: PortId, publications: List<Publication>)
    fun publishTargets(state: BlockRunState, targets: TargetBatch)
    fun borrowRequests(input: Facts): List<RequestedRow>
    fun borrowRequest(slot: Run1Slot): RequestRowView
    fun commitRequests(state: BlockRunState, temporary: RequestStorage)
    fun staticMarkRequest(initial: InitialAp, mark: TaintMark)
    fun staticTicket(): Long
    fun routeStaticToExit(state: BlockRunState, node: CommonInst, original: PremiseKey, value: Facts)
    fun methodBoundary(state: BlockRunState, node: CommonInst, original: PremiseKey, value: Facts,
                       summary: Boolean)
    fun keepLocalConclusion(exit: PortId, value: Facts): Boolean = true
    /** Query-only normalized C5. Null delegates to the native demand view. */
    fun intersectSummary(exit: PortId, original: PremiseKey, raw: Facts): List<Facts>? = null
    fun prepareExit(exit: PortId, base: AccessPathBase): PreparedExit? = null
    fun deliveryStatistics(): BlockDeliveryStatistics? = null
}

internal data class BlockDeliveryStatistics(val hits: Long, val searches: Long, val visited: Long,
                                          val destinations: Long, val maxWidth: Int)

/** The method actor routes the original boundary stages into their genuine local spans. */
internal interface MethodRootRouting {
    fun start(node: CommonInst, original: InitialAp, value: Facts)
    fun enter(node: CommonInst, original: PremiseKey, value: Facts)
    fun successors(node: CommonInst, original: PremiseKey, value: Facts)
    /** Query-only normalized C5. Null delegates to the native demand view. */
    fun intersectSummary(exit: PortId, original: PremiseKey, raw: Facts): List<Facts>? = null
}

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine

import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.ApOps
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.Facts
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.AdmittedInitial
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.Layer
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.MethodKey
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.DirectedForms
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.CallerRef

/** Only post can be called by a publisher on another unit's thread. */
interface RunnerPort<A : RunActor> {
    val config: RunConfig
    val shared: SharedObjects
    val forms: DirectedForms
    val ops: ApOps
    val steps: ProtocolSteps
    val staticService: Run1StaticService? get() = null
    fun sendStatic(effect: StaticOwnerEffect): Boolean = send(RunEvent.StaticOwner(effect))
    fun send(event: RunEvent): Boolean
    fun post(event: RunEvent.TargetDelivery): Boolean = error("Terminal delivery needs its subscribed runner")
    fun post(event: RunEvent.Delivery): Boolean
    fun post(event: RunEvent.ChangedRequests): Boolean = error("Request delivery needs its subscribed runner")
    fun enqueue(analyzer: A): Boolean
    fun analyzer(key: MethodKey): A
    fun summaryStorage(key: MethodKey): SummaryStorage
    fun subscribe(sub: Subscription)
    fun link(callee: MethodKey, ref: CallerRef, linkLayer: Layer, added: Facts)
    fun startInitials(callee: MethodKey, initials: Collection<AdmittedInitial>)

    val onProcess: ((MethodKey, EdgeDelta) -> Unit)? get() = null
    val onCut: ((Cut, Facts) -> Unit)? get() = null
}

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine

import kotlinx.coroutines.DelicateCoroutinesApi
import kotlinx.coroutines.ExecutorCoroutineDispatcher
import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
import kotlinx.coroutines.newFixedThreadPoolContext
import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.LanguageManager
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.ApManager
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.ApOps
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.FormCacheStatistics
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.Interpreter
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.UnresolvedCallObserver
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.RecordStore
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.N1Statistics
import org.opentaint.dataflow.ifds.UnitResolver
import org.opentaint.dataflow.util.Cancellation
import org.opentaint.dataflow.util.RefManager
import org.opentaint.ir.api.common.CommonMethod
import kotlin.time.Duration
import kotlin.time.Duration.Companion.seconds

/** Analysis owners shared across runs; each run creates its own mutable engine state. */
class SharedObjects(
    val ap: ApManager,
    val ops: ApOps,
    val interpreter: Interpreter,
    val language: LanguageManager,
    val contexts: MethodContextCache,
    val records: RecordStore,
    val unitResolver: UnitResolver<CommonMethod>,
    val refManager: RefManager,
    val cancellation: Cancellation,
    threads: Int = (Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors() / 2).coerceAtLeast(1),
    val cancellationTimeout: Duration = 30.seconds,
    val diagnostics: Boolean = false,
    val formStatistics: FormCacheStatistics? = null,
    releaseRun1CatalogCoverage: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    val abstractionStatistics: Run1AbstractionStatistics? =
        if (java.lang.Boolean.getBoolean("org.opentaint.bidi.optimizationStatistics")) Run1AbstractionStatistics() else null,
    val n1Statistics: N1Statistics? = if (java.lang.Boolean.getBoolean("org.opentaint.bidi.optimizationStatistics")) N1Statistics() else null,
    val n2Statistics: N2Statistics? = if (java.lang.Boolean.getBoolean("org.opentaint.bidi.optimizationStatistics")) N2Statistics() else null,
    val requestBatchStatistics: RequestBatchStatistics? =
        if (java.lang.Boolean.getBoolean("org.opentaint.bidi.optimizationStatistics")) RequestBatchStatistics() else null,
    staticCallGraph: org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.DetachedStaticCallGraph =
        org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.DetachedStaticCallGraph.EMPTY,
) : AutoCloseable {
    val reportCatalog = ReportCatalog()
    val normalRuleContributors = org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.NormalRuleContributorStore(ap)
    val staticGuidanceInterner = org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.StaticGuidanceInterner(ap)
    val staticWriteKeyInterner = org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.StaticWriteKeyInterner(ap)
    var staticCallGraph = staticCallGraph
        private set
    @OptIn(DelicateCoroutinesApi::class, ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
    val dispatcher: ExecutorCoroutineDispatcher = newFixedThreadPoolContext(threads, "bidi-worker")

    /** Call only after run-1 workers have joined. No static request catalog exists. */
    private var releaseCoverage: (() -> Unit)? = releaseRun1CatalogCoverage
    fun releaseRun1CatalogCoverage() {
        val release = releaseCoverage
        releaseCoverage = null
        release?.invoke()
        staticGuidanceInterner.clear()
        staticWriteKeyInterner.clear()
        staticCallGraph = org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.DetachedStaticCallGraph.EMPTY
    }

    val unresolvedObserver: UnresolvedCallObserver? get() = interpreter as? UnresolvedCallObserver

    override fun close() { releaseRun1CatalogCoverage(); dispatcher.close() }
}

/** Check bounded actual run-2 inputs. A correlated field STAR keeps its E.
 * Returns true for a named FULL field and false for an exact class marker.
 * Acceptance does not authorize an initial or add a source/sink literal shape. */
internal fun validateRun2StaticFullInput(ap: ApManager, actual: Pattern, fieldLimit: Int = 1): Boolean {
    require(fieldLimit >= 1) { "The field limit must be positive" }
    val field = validateRun2StaticFullAnchor(ap, actual) ?: return false
    val fact = actual.fact
    val location = if (field) fact.path.drop(1).all { it.isCounted() } &&
        fact.path.count { it.isCounted() } <= fieldLimit &&
        (fact.tail == Tail.EXACT || fact.tail == Tail.ANY || fact.tail == Tail.STAR)
    else fact.path.size == 1 && fact.tail == Tail.EXACT
    val exclusion = actual.exclusion == ExclusionSet.Empty || field && fact.tail == Tail.STAR
    check(location && exclusion) {
        "Unsupported run-2 concrete static input: $actual. " +
            "Expected a named field within limit $fieldLimit with EXACT/ANY and empty field exclusions, " +
            "a named field with correlated STAR and its legal field exclusion, " +
            "or an EXACT class marker with empty field exclusions. Backward MUST is forbidden."
    }
    return field
}

/** Check only the static anchor of a current result. Its existing header stays
 * intact; the bounded backward-input validator separately rejects MUST.
 * Deeper field suffixes are lawful before the normal field cut.
 * Returns true for a named field, false for an exact class marker, null otherwise. */
internal fun validateRun2StaticFullAnchor(ap: ApManager, actual: Pattern): Boolean? {
    if (actual.fact.base != STATIC) return null
    val atom = (actual.fact.mark as? MarkSlot.Concrete)?.mark ?: return null
    if (ap.marks.fullId(atom) == null) return null // GROUP guidance is metadata, not an actual FULL mark.
    val path = actual.fact.path
    val field = path.size >= 2 && path[0].isClass() &&
        ap.accessors.accessor(path[1]) is FieldAccessor
    val exactClass = path.size == 1 && path[0].isClass() && actual.fact.tail == Tail.EXACT
    check(field || exactClass) {
        "Unsupported run-2 concrete static input: $actual. " +
            "Expected a named JVM static field anchor or an EXACT class marker; " +
            "broad root/class marks require a separate query adapter (run1-static-summary-erasure.md section 3)."
    }
    return field
}

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine

import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.ApOps

/** Notification posts to this subscribed runner, independently of the callee's unit. */
interface SubscriptionPort {
    val config: RunConfig
    val ops: ApOps
    val steps: ProtocolSteps
    val statistics: N2Statistics? get() = null
    val abstractionStatistics: Run1AbstractionStatistics? get() = null
    val requestBatchStatistics: RequestBatchStatistics? get() = null
    val staticService: Run1StaticService? get() = null
    fun summaryStorage(key: MethodKey): SummaryStorage
    fun applier(key: MethodKey): SummaryApplier
    fun post(event: RunEvent.TargetDelivery): Boolean = error("Terminal delivery needs its subscribed runner")
    fun post(event: RunEvent.Delivery): Boolean
    fun post(event: RunEvent.ChangedRequests): Boolean = error("Request delivery needs its subscribed runner")
    /** Must enqueue, including same-unit answers/climbs; never invoke an actor inline during a visit. */
    fun send(event: RunEvent): Boolean = error("Question results need counted queued delivery")
}

/** The actual method handler supplies subscriptions and releases them after joining. */
interface SubscriptionHandler {
    fun subscribe(sub: Subscription)
    fun freeze()
}
